{"notes":"Design decision: Medium assigns quirks (option B), not radio declares.

API:
- medium.set_quirks_profile('moderate') — global default
- medium.set_quirks('node-7', QuirkProfile(...)) — per-node override
- medium.set_quirks('node-3', PRESETS['sx1276']) — named hardware preset

Named presets as data:
- PRESETS['ideal'] — no quirks (deterministic tests)
- PRESETS['moderate'] — typical real-world
- PRESETS['sx1276'] — specific chip characteristics
- PRESETS['garbage'] — stress testing

QuirkProfile fields: warmup_ms, pll_fail_rate, crystal_ppm, rssi_noise_db, cad_false_positive_rate, cad_false_negative_rate, rx_deaf_us"}
